description.value:
Before the Last War, House Orien's reach spanned Khorvaire, and its trade roads and lightning rails were the lifeblood of a thriving kingdom. The war severed those arteries, killing Galifar and leaving House Orien bloodied. Its couriers and shippers still keep goods moving on both sides of the continent, but restoring routes across the Mournland remains the house's highest priority. Meanwhile, Orien adventurers serve the house by looking into missing couriers, recovering goods stolen from caravans, and resolving disruptions on the lightning rail.

Ability Scores: Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.backgrounds-feats.Item.aYCwwlhAPiZiaAQw]{Mark of Passage}

Skill Proficiencies: Acrobatics and Athletics

Tool Proficiency: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulCartograph]{Cartographer's Tools}

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulCartograph]{Cartographer's Tools}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesFine]{Fine Clothes}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagMap00000000]{Map}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagCaseMaporSc]{Map or Scroll Case}, 18 GP; or (B) 50 GP
